description: Returns the recorded lines a named player appeared in, as cited rows told from the player's side, with the player's record, which is already counted by season, team and stage. Call it when someone asks about a player's results, form or history. Never guess at their injury or availability, because the Desk does not hold it.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

includeAllSeasons.description: Set true ONLY when the user explicitly asks about prior years / all history.

player.description: Player name to resolve, e.g. 'First Last'. Or the player's Desk page link or number.

season.description: Optional season year to filter to, e.g. 2026

name: query_player_history
title: A player's recent results
